Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১) The Antonym of ‘Enigma’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Enigma is a noun.
Meaning of enigma - person or thing that is mysterious or difficult to understand.(হেয়ালি; প্রহেলিকা)
Synonym - mystery, puzzle, riddle, conundrum, paradox, problem, unsolved problem, question, question mark, quandary, a closed book
Antonym - overt, naked, public, acknowledged.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২) Which of the following words is not similar to the meaning of the word ‘Restraint’?
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Restraint (noun):
Meaning - A measure or condition that keeps someone or something under control.
Bangla Meaning: (বাধা, দমন, সংযম)
Example: Decisions are made within the financial restraints of the budget.
Synonym: constraint, check, control, restriction, limitation, curtailment
Antonym: incitement,

The meaning of other words:
Repression: দমন, শাসন
Hindrance/obstacle: thing that provides resistance, delay, or obstruction to something or someone. (বাধা,প্রতিবন্ধক)
example: a hindrance to the development process.
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৩) The synonym of ‘Surge’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Surge (noun):
Meaning: a sudden increase of a strong feeling
Bengali Meaning: ঢেউ; ঊর্মি; স্ফীতি; উত্থাল; তরঙ্গ; দোল;
Synonym: rush, outpouring, stream, flow, sweep
Antonym: decline, decrease
Meaning of other words:
Strain: behaviour or ways of behaving(টান টান করে ) মেলে ধরা
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৪) The synonym of ‘Stigma'-
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Stigma(noun):
Meaning: Strong feeling of disapproval that most people in a society have about something, especially when this is unfair.
Bengali meaning: কলঙ্ক, নিন্দা, লোহা;ছেকার দাগ
Synonym: shame, disgrace, dishonour, stain
Antonym: honour, credit
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৫) The Antonym of ‘Augment’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Augment (verb):
Meaning: Make (something) greater by adding to it; increase
Bengali meaning: বাড়া বা বৃদ্ধি পাওয়া
Synonym: increase, make larger, make bigger, make greater, add to, supplement, build up, enlarge, expand, extend, raise, multiply, elevate, swell, inflate
Antonym: decrease

Bengali meaning of other word:
Diminish: হ্রাস পাওয়া
Hieghten: বৃদ্ধি পাওয়া
Intensity: তীব্রতা বা প্রবলতা
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৬) Will you kindly <u>open</u> the knot? The closest opposite meaning of the underlined word is-
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
এটা Knot ধরে ব্যাখ্যা ও উত্তর দেওয়া। কিন্তু প্রশ্নে আন্ডারলাইন - open এর নিচে। তাই, উত্তর No answer ধরা হয়েছে।

Knot (noun):
Meaning: A fastening made by looping a piece of string, rope, or something similar on itself and tightening it.
Bengali meaning: গ্রন্থি, গাঁট; বন্ধন; সমস্যা বা জটিলতা; সামুদ্রিক মাইল
Synonym: tie, twist, loop, bow, splice, splicing, join, link
Antonym: untie
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৭) The Synonym of ‘Impute’-
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Impute (verb)
Meaning: Represent (something, especially something undesirable) as being done or possessed by someone
Bengali meaning: আরোপ করা
Synonym: blame, attribute, ascribe, assign, credit, accredit, chalk up
Antonym: defend, exculpate
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৮) A ________ makes no difference between man and man in spreading his love
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Philanthropist (noun):
Bengali meaning: মানুষে মানুষে কোন ভেদাভেদ খুঁজে না এবং সবার জন্য যার ভালোবাসা রয়েছে; বিশ্বপ্রেমিক।
Synonym: humanitarian, patron, patroness, donor, contributor, giver, sponsor, backer, helper, altruist, good Samaritan
Antonym: Self - seeking, self - indulgent

The meaning of other words:
Philander: হালকা ভাবে প্রেমের সম্পর্ক স্থাপন করে।
Philistine: সংস্কৃতি বিবর্জিত অসভ্য মানুষ।

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৯) He had a wonderful <u>gift of the gab</u>. The underline part means-
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Gift of the gab (Phrase):
Meaning: The ability to speak with eloquence and fluency.
SYNONYMS:
eloquence, fluency, clarity of speech, expressiveness, articulateness.
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১০) A preposterous person is -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Preposterous (adjective)
Meaning: Contrary to reason or common sense; utterly absurd or ridiculous
Bengali meaning: অসংগত ; অসম্ভব ; ভ্রান্ত ; নির্বুদ্ধিতাপূর্ণ
Synonym: absurd, ridiculous, foolish, stupid, ludicrous, farcical, laughable, comical, risible, hare-brained, asinine, inane, nonsensical, pointless, senseless, insane, unreasonable, irrational, illogical
Antonym: reasonable, sensible

Meaning of other word
Absurd এর অর্থ উদ্ভট বা অসঙ্গগত
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১১) The synonym of “Repercussion” -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Repercussion (noun):
Meaning: Repercussion is an unintended consequence of an event or action, especially an unwelcome one.
Bengali meaning: প্রতিক্রিয়া
Synonym: consequence, result, effect, outcome, by-product reverberation, backlash, ripple, shock wave aftermath, footprint, fallout.
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১২) The antonym of “Surreptitious” -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Surreptitious(adjective):
Meaning: Kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of.
Bengali Meaning: গুপ্ত,গোপনে করা; গোপনীয়
Synonym: secret, sly, covert
Antonym words are Open, overt
Source : Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১৩) The synonym of ‘Prodigal’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Prodigal (adjective)
Meaning: Spending money or using resources freely and recklessly; wastefully extravagant.
Synonym words of 'Prodigal' are wasteful, extravagant, spendthrift, improvident, imprudent, immoderate, profligate, thriftless, excessive, intemperate, irresponsible, self-indulgent, reckless, wanton(অপব্যয়ী; অপচয়ী; অমিতব্যয়ী; প্রচুর; উড়নচণ্ডে; উড়নচড়ে; অপচয়ী; অপব্যয়ী; উড়নচণ্ডে; অমিতব্যয়ী;)
Antonym words are thrifty, economical, parsimonious
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১৪) The antonym of ‘Tranquil' -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Tranquil (adjective):
Meaning: Spending money or using resources freely and recklessly; wastefully extravagant.
Bengali meaning: শান্ত ; সুস্থির
Synonym: peaceful, restful, reposeful, calm, quiet, still, serene, placid, relaxing, soothing, undisturbed, idyllic, halcyon, mild, pleasant
Antotyn: disturbed, busy, restless
Source : Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১৫) The synonym of ‘vigilant’
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Vigilant (adjective):
Meaning: Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties.
Bengali Meaning: যে কোন বিপদ সম্বন্ধেসদা সতর্ক
Synonym: observant, sharp-eyed, keen-eyed, gimlet-eyed, eagle-eyed, hawk-eyed, with eyes like a hawk, with one's eyes open, keeping one's eyes peeled, keeping one's eyes skinned, attentive, paying attention, alert, on the alert, 
Antonym: negligent, inattentive
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১৬) The synonym word of “Inexplicable” -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Inexplicable (adjective):
Meaning: unable to be explained or accounted for.
Bengali Meaning: ব্যাখ্যাতীত; দুর্বোধ্য
Synonym: unexplainable, incomprehensible, unfathomable, impenetrable, insoluble, unsolvable, baffling, puzzling, perplexing, mystifying, bewildering, mysterious, strange, weird, abstruse, enigmatic

Unaccountable = Unable to be explained.
বাংলা অর্থ - কারণ নির্ণয় করা যায় না এমন; অব্যাখ্যেয়; ব্যাখ্যাতীত।

Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১৭) The Antonym of “Assuage” -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Assuage(verb):
Meaning: Make (an unpleasant feeling) less intense.
Bengali Meaning: ( প্রশমিত করা; উপশম করা; শান্ত করা, হ্রাস করা; কমানো; তীব্রতা লাঘব করা; নিবৃত্ত করা;)
Synonym: relieve, ease, alleviate, soothe, mitigate, dampen, allay, calm, palliate, abate, lull, temper, suppress, smother, stifle, subdue, tranquilise, mollify, moderate, modify, tone down, attenuate, dilute, lessen, diminish, decrease, reduce, lower
Antonym: intensify, aggravate, exacerbate.
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১৮) The Synonym of ‘Capricious’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Capricious (verb):
Meaning: Given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood or behaviour./Changing according to no discernible rules; unpredictable.
Bengali meaning: খামখেয়ালী
Synonym: fickle, inconstant, changeable, variable, unstable, mercurial, volatile, erratic, vacillating, irregular, inconsistent, fitful, arbitrary, impulsive, temperamental, wild, ungovernable, whimsical, fanciful, flighty, wayward, quirky, faddish, freakish, unpredictable, random, chance, haphazard
Antonym: stable, consistent.
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ১৯) The antonym of ‘Loquacious’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Loquacious (verb)
Meaning: Tending to talk a great deal
Bengali Meaning: বাঁচাল
Synonym: talkative, garrulous, voluble, over-talkative, long-winded, wordy, verbose, profuse, prolix, effusive, gushing, rambling, chatty, gossipy, gossiping, chattering, chattery, babbling, blathering, gibbering, the gift of the gab, having kissed the blarney stone, yakking, big-mouthed, gabby, gassy, talky
Antonym:reticent, taciturn
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২০) Something that is _______ is boring and uninteresting
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Superfluous (adjective)
Meaning: Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough.
Bengali meaning: প্রয়োজনের অতিরিক্ত
Example: the purchaser should avoid asking for superfluous information
Synonym: surplus, redundant, unneeded, not required, excess, extra, spare, to spare, remaining, unused, leftover
Antonym: necessary, essential
Meaning of other words:

Overt: প্রকাশ্যেকৃত, প্রতীয়মান
conspicuous: সুস্পষ্ট; প্রসিদ্ধ; বিশিষ্ট; স্পষ্টলক্ষিত; দৃষ্টি-আকর্ষণকারী;
unconcealed: অনাবৃত; অগুপ্ত; অপ্রচ্ছন্ন; প্রকট; সুস্পষ্ট; অসংগুপ্ত; অলুক্কায়িত; অগূঢ়;
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২১) The synonym of ‘Stringent’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Stringent (adjective)
Meaning: of regulations, requirements, or conditions
Bengali meaning: কঠোর; বাধ্যতামূলক
Synonym: strict, firm, rigid, rigorous, severe, harsh, tough, tight, exacting, demanding, inflexible, stiff, hard and fast, uncompromising, draconian, extreme
Antonym: lenient, flexible
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২২) An ________ condition or quality is one that is starting to happen or appear.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Incipient (adjective)
Meaning: Beginning to happen or develop.
Bengali meaning: প্রাথমিক; প্রথম
Synonym: developing, impending, growing, emerging, emergent,starting, inceptive, initial,embryonic, fledgling, in its infancy, germinal
Antonym: full-blown
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২৩) The antonym of ‘Din’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Din (noun):
Meaning: A loud, unpleasant, and prolonged noise.
Bengali meaning: এক টানা উচ্চ শব্দ
Synonym: racket, loud noise, confused noise, commotion, cacophony, babel, hubbub, tumult, fracas, clangour, crash, clatter, clash
Antonym: silence, quiet, serenity.
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২৪) The Antonym of ‘Palpable’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Palpable (adjective):
Meaning: (of a feeling or atmosphere) so intense as to seem almost tangible.
Bengali meaning: স্পর্শেন্দ্রিয়াগ্রাহ্য, স্পষ্ট
Synonym: tangible, touchable, noticeable, detectable, solid, concrete, material, substantial, real,perceptible, perceivable, visible, noticeable, appreciable, discernible, detectable, observable, tangible, recognizable, notable, unmistakable, transparent, indisputable, self-evident, incontrovertible, incontestable, undeniable
Antonym: intangible, imperceptible
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২৫) Someone who is _______ at something can do it skillfully.
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Adept (adjective)
Meaning: Very skilled or proficient at something.
Bengali meaning: সুদক্ষ ব্যক্তি
Synonym: expert, proficient, accomplished, skilful, talented, gifted, masterly, virtuoso, consummate, peerless, adroit, dexterous, deft, nimble-fingered, handy, artful, able, capable, competent.
Antonym: inept, mediocre.
Meaning of other word:
Maladroit: জবুথবু; অনিপুণ; অদক্ষ; কৌশলশূন্য; কৌশলহীন; অপটু;
Naive: সরল, সাদাসিধে, অকপট
Awkward: বেঢপ, অপ্রতিভ
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২৬) The synonym of ‘Regime’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Regime (noun):
Meaning: A government, especially an authoritarian one.
Bengali meaning: শাসন; সরকার; আমল; শাসনব্যবস্থা; রাজ্যশাসনপ্রণালী; প্রচলিত ব্যবস্থা;
Synonym : government, authorities, system of government, rule, reign, dominion, sovereignty, jurisdiction, authority, control, command, administration, establishment, direction, management, leadership.
Antonym : anarchy, disorder, chaos.

Meaning of other words :
Clique: জোট, ক্ষুদ্র দল
Cabal: গুপ্ত অভি সন্ধির জন্য মিলিত দল; ষড়যন্ত্র
Gang: দল; (শ্রমিক; কয়েদী); দল
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২৭) The antonym of ‘Fickle’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Fickle(adjective):
Meaning: Changing frequently, especially as regards one's loyalties or affections..
Bengali meaning - চঞ্চল; অস্থির; পরিবর্তনশীল
Synonym: capricious, changeable, variable, volatile, mercurial, vacillating, fitful, irregular, inconstant, disloyal, undependable, unstable, unsteady, unfaithful, faithless.
Antonym: constant, stable

Meaning of other words:
Diseased: অসুস্থ; পীড়িত; ব্যাধিগ্রস্ত; ব্যায়রামী;
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২৮) He enjoyed the <u>salubrious</u> climate of the place. The meaning of underline word is -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Salubrious(adjective):
Bengali meaning: স্বাস্থ্যজনক
Example: With its salubrious weather, few would want to move out.
Synonym: healthy, health-giving, healthful, beneficial, good for one's health, wholesome, salutary
Antonym: unhealthy

Meaning of other words:
temperate: পরিমিত; সংযমী
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ২৯) The antonym of ‘Effete’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Effete (adjective):
Meaning: Affected, over-refined, and ineffectual.
Bengali meaning: ক্লান্ত; ক্ষয়প্রাপ্ত
Example : The aristocracy are slightly unreal and living in an effete world.
Synonym: affected, over-refined, ineffectual, artificial, studied, pretentious, precious, chi-chi, flowery, mannered
Antonym: unpretentious

Meaning of other words:
Adamant : অত্যন্ত কঠিন বস্তু, জেদী
Bold: সাহসী
Source: Oxford Dictionary

Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.question: ৩০) The synonym of ‘Baffle’ -
Word Meaning, Synonyms & Antonyms.exp:
Baffle (adjective):
Meaning: Totally bewilder or perplex.
Bengali meaning: ব্যর্থ করা, হতবুদ্ধি করা
Example: They will be totally baffled and will need a lawyer to know what it means
Synonym: frustrate, perplex, puzzle, bewilder, mystify, bemuse, confuse, confound, nonplus, disconcert, throw, set someone thinking
Antonym: enlighten

Meaning of other words:
Antagonize: বিরোধীতা করা
Source: Oxford Dictionary
